name: Classics Illustrated
paper_stock: cardstock cover; glossy interior (some issued with bond)
notes:
Reprints from the Gilberton Classics Illustrated series with a few new titles (#59, 61 & 62). Titles are not numbered except as part of the ISBN which coincides with their publication order. Announced in 1996, the series first saw distribution of four issues in February 1997. The first few issues have 1996 copyright dates. However, the actual cover dates can be determined from the publication schedule found on the inside back cover or inside front cover of each issue. The series collapsed in early-1998 and many announced titles were never printed.

name: The Legend of Zelda
notes:
Based on Nintendo licensed characters. There are two series. Both series identify as Volume 1 in indicia. The first run is $1.95 each, undated covers (May 1990 through September 1990). These are listed in series http://www.comics.org/series/16511/ Link: The Legend of Zelda (Acclaim / Valiant, 1990 Series).

A reprint run started nine months later. Each is $1.50, with months on the covers (February 1991 through June 1991). The second run reverses the covers used on issues 2 and 4. Contents of issues are also different, with some stories being printed in different issues or omitted. These are listed in series http://www.comics.org/series/39934/ The Legend of Zelda (Acclaim / Valiant, 1990 Series).

A sixth issue was planned for the second run and mentioned in the letters page of #5, but not produced. The content may have been repurposed for Nintendo Comics System (Acclaim / Valiant, 1991 Series) #7, which contains stories named as being in the sixth issue.

ISSN 1049-1481.
